description: Curated catalog of global skills: the single source for the skill table in every agent's generated instructions. lib/prompt.mjs reconciles it against the actual skills/global/*/ directories (run: node harness.mjs check) and fails if they disagree, so a new skill cannot silently drift out of the tables.

brainstorming.tagline: Clarify intent/requirements/design before building or changing behavior

writing-plans.tagline: Write a multi-step implementation plan before coding

test-driven-development.tagline: Write tests before implementing or fixing

verification-before-completion.tagline: Verify with evidence before claiming done

handoff.tagline: Compact the session into a handoff doc for the next agent

action-first.tagline: Output-style toggle: action first, no preamble/recap (user-invoked)

skill-find.tagline: Recommend pack skills for the project and link them in (harness add)

skill-creator.tagline: Write a new skill, or audit a skill or CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md against the rubric

skill-scanner.tagline: Security-scan a community skill before installing it

skillspector.tagline: Second security scan (NVIDIA SkillSpector, 0-100 risk score) before installing or publishing a skill

improve-codebase-architecture.tagline: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities → visual HTML report (user-invoked)

openspec-explore.tagline: Think through a spec before writing it

openspec-propose.tagline: Generate a full change proposal (design/specs/tasks) in one step

openspec-apply-change.tagline: Implement an OpenSpec change task by task

officecli.tagline: Create/edit/render .docx/.xlsx/.pptx via the officecli binary (formulas, pivots, HTML/PNG)
